## 7. ESSENTIAL CLINICAL GUIDANCE FOR PATIENT PREPARATION

### Fasting Guidelines
- **Fasting Required (10–12 Hours)**: Lipid Profile, Iron Profile, Homocysteine. (Plain water permitted; no tea, coffee, milk, or breakfast).
- **Fasting Required (8–10 Hours)**: Fasting Blood Sugar (FBS), Fasting Insulin, HOMA-IR, C-Peptide.
- **No Fasting Required**: Complete Blood Count (CBC), HbA1c, Thyroid Profile (T3/T4/TSH), Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Vitamin D3, Vitamin B12, All STI & HIV serology and PCR tests.

### STI Specimen Rules
- **First-Catch Urine (for Chlamydia/Gonorrhea/Trichomonas PCR)**: Must NOT urinate for 1–2 hours before sample collection. Collect the first 20–30 mL stream of urine (do not discard initial stream).
- **Pharyngeal Swabs (Oral Exposure)**: Avoid food, hot drinks, mouthwash, or brushing teeth for 1 hour before collection. Flocked Dacron swab collected from bilateral posterior pharyngeal wall and tonsillar pillars.
- **Venous Blood Serology (HIV/Syphilis/Hepatitis)**: Venous draw by trained phlebotomist; fingerstick rapid tests are NOT used at our reference laboratory due to superior analytical sensitivity of 4th Gen ECLIA.
